title: abcd
script:
-- ZopGui (Clean Version, No XD Buttons)
-- Green outline, full features, no troll/confuse/XD buttons
-- Decal ID: 73318024625962

local ZopGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui"))
ZopGui.Name = "ZopGui"

local Main = Instance.new("Frame", ZopGui)
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 600)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -250, 0.5, -300)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Main.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
Main.BorderSizePixel = 4
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner", Main)
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local function createButton(name, posY, callback)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 460, 0, 40)
	button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, posY)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
	button.BorderSizePixel = 2
	button.Text = name
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	button.Font = Enum.Font.Antique
	button.TextSize = 18
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	return button
end

-- [ Add buttons with core features ]
createButton("Decal Spam", 20, function()
	for _, p in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local d = Instance.new("Decal", p)
				d.Texture = "rbxassetid://73318024625962"
				d.Face = face
			end
		end
	end
	local sky = Instance.new("Sky", game.Lighting)
	sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://73318024625962"
	sky.SkyboxDn = sky.SkyboxBk
	sky.SkyboxFt = sky.SkyboxBk
	sky.SkyboxLf = sky.SkyboxBk
	sky.SkyboxRt = sky.SkyboxBk
	sky.SkyboxUp = sky.SkyboxBk
end)

createButton("Scream (Spooky Scary)", 70, function()
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://160762912"
	sound.Volume = 10
	sound:Play()
end)

createButton("Kill All", 120, function()
	for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			p.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end)

createButton("Give GUI to All", 170, function()
	for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		ZopGui:Clone().Parent = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	end
end)

createButton("Toad Rain", 220, function()
	for i = 1, 50 do
		local toad = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
		toad.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
		toad.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100), 100, math.random(-100,100))
		toad.Anchored = false
		toad.Name = "Toad"
		local d = Instance.new("Decal", toad)
		d.Texture = "rbxassetid://73318024625962"
		d.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	end
end)

local playerBox = Instance.new("TextBox", Main)
playerBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 30)
playerBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 270)
playerBox.PlaceholderText = "Type player name..."
playerBox.Font = Enum.Font.Antique
playerBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
playerBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
playerBox.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
playerBox.TextSize = 16

local enterBtn = createButton("Rain Player", 310, function()
	local target = playerBox.Text
	for i = 1, 30 do
		local p = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target)
		if p and p.Character then
			local clone = p.Character:Clone()
			clone.Parent = workspace
			clone:MoveTo(Vector3.new(math.random(-100,100), 100, math.random(-100,100)))
		end
	end
end)

-- Additional features here (Light/Dark Mode, Spin, Earthquake, Finder, Injector, etc)
-- You can extend this based on your full feature list as needed

-- Branding
local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", Main)
img.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 80)
img.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 10)
img.Image = "rbxassetid://73318024625962"
img.BackgroundTransparency = 1

-- Screen Cover
local cover = Instance.new("TextLabel", ZopGui)
cover.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
cover.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
cover.Text = "zopzop's here"
cover.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
cover.Font = Enum.Font.Antique
cover.TextScaled = true
wait(5)
cover:Destroy()
